title: validation.rs precondition comment names non-existent callers
description: The precondition comment in validation.rs says the NNTP POST path satisfies the obs-fold unfold precondition via reader/session/lifecycle.rs and reader/post/did_passthrough.rs. But validate_article_ingress is not currently called from the reader crate at all — only from transit pipeline tests with pre-constructed Article structs. The comment describes imagined future callers, not actual ones. Fix: rewrite as a general statement ('all callers must ensure obs-fold is unfolded before constructing the Article') without naming specific modules that may or may not call this function in the future.
